title: Public Provident Fund (PPF) EEE Tax Status & Compounding
source: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
content: Public Provident Fund (PPF) highlights: 1. EEE Status: Principal investment deductible under 80C, annual interest compound tax-free, and maturity proceeds completely tax-free. 2. Lock-in: 15 years, extendable in 5-year blocks. 3. Safety: Sovereign guarantee with guaranteed interest rate revised quarterly by the Government. 4. Annual Deposit Limits: Minimum ₹500, maximum ₹1,50,000 per financial year.
